__provenance__.table: canon_engine_key (LEFT JOIN canon_corpus on kit_id for the naming columns)
__provenance__.query: SELECT ek.kit_id AS kit_id, ek.cell_key AS cell_key, ek.geometry_value AS geometry_value, ek.delivery_value AS delivery_value, ek.ctrl_treatment AS ctrl_treatment, ek.ctrl_function AS ctrl_function, ek.def_bin AS def_bin, ek.economy_model AS economy_model, ek.activation_val AS activation_val, ek.dependency_val AS dependency_val, ek.mob_policy_while_casting AS mob_policy_while_casting, cc.proxy_val AS proxy_val, cc.range_val AS range_val, cc.tempo_val AS tempo_val, cc.amp_val AS amp_val, cc.commit_val AS commit_val FROM canon_engine_key ek LEFT JOIN canon_corpus cc ON cc.kit_id = ek.kit_id WHERE ek.cell_key IS NOT NULL AND ek.cell_key != '';
